fields.statement: Verifier at 0d7a957f: read the diff of internal/session/names.go and names_test.go. ChangeSetSlug(sets, cs) takes the folded change sets, returns Slug(DisplayTitle) and appends '-' + strings.ToLower(first 12 ID chars) only when another set with a lower ID (id.Compare, state never consulted, sets without an open entry skipped) has the same title slug, so landing, abandoning or creating later sets cannot change it. Ran go test -trimpath -count=1 -run TestChangeSetSlug -v ./internal/session/ (PASS) and go test -trimpath ./internal/session/... (ok); go vet and gofmt -l clean. TestChangeSetSlug checks: the earlier (landed) set keeps the bare slug 'fix-the-usage-governor-s'; the later one gets 'fix-the-usage-governor-s-01m6t2dc1234'; a no-clash set keeps 'other-work'; a set whose ID shares 25 characters with another still gets the fixed 12-character suffix; after the earlier set is withdrawn (abandoned) the later one keeps its suffix across repeated calls; without the earlier set it is bare.
